answer: A proof-of-burn mechanism curbs Sybil attacks by requiring agents to destroy economic nectar, earned as protocol fees, to mint an identity relic. This credential binds to clock drift from an onboard quartz crystal oscillator, forcing attackers to burn scarce capital and purchase dedicated physical hardware for each pseudonym. However, this barrier penalizes honest new agents without prior earnings and cannot prevent capital-rich adversaries from subsidizing mass deployment.
